purpose: One row per candidate source awaiting an artifact-level human rights decision. This artifact records rights review only. It contains no claim-to-source mapping and creates no citation validation, technical review, instructional review, approval, or eligibility change.
invariants: Rights decisions require a real reviewer identity and timestamp. Never synthesise or auto-promote a reviewer.
Each source is reviewed on its own exact artifact; presence in this file is not clearance.
Candidate classifications in the discovery manifest are candidates, never decisions, and are not promoted by this file.
Rights review alone does not authorize claim-to-source mapping; mapping is a separate branch and a separate gate.
No question payload, excerpt, or proprietary text may be stored from this review.
rights_classification_note: Clearance is scope-specific: a narrower cleared value never implies a broader one, and no value other than pending may be recorded until a named human reviewer records reviewer_identity and reviewed_at for that exact artifact. Rights classification is separate from evidence suitability, citation validation, technical review, instructional review, approval, and eligibility.

reviews.scope_of_clearance: Authoritative-source linking and factual citation to DOE-HDBK-1084-95, including section/page locators. This clearance does not authorize full-text storage, reproduction, RAG ingestion, model training, derivative-content rights, or commercial republication.
reviews.review_notes: Human review approved by Rafael Rodriguez Jr. DOE-HDBK-1084-95 is an official U.S. Department of Energy handbook and carries Distribution Statement A: approved for public release; distribution is unlimited. Because public release and federal provenance do not by themselves establish unrestricted reuse rights for every incorporated component, this review intentionally grants only link-and-citation clearance. No broader reuse permission is inferred.

reviews.prior_rights_observation: data/evidence/source-state-registry.json records cleared-text-only-cc-by-4.0 for the exact hashed artifact, attributed to a named human reviewer. That prior decision is provenance for this slice; it is not a decision here and does not authorize mapping or excerpts.

required_before_any_decision: Capture the candidate artifact, record its SHA-256, and confirm the canonical identity and revision of that exact artifact.
A named human reviewer records reviewer_identity, reviewed_at, decided_rights_classification, scope_of_clearance and review_notes for that artifact only.
Unclear or conflicting reuse rights keep the source candidate-only; they are not approved evidence.
Update the validator in the same change that records the first real decision so the decided-state contract is explicit and fail-closed.
Rights review does not authorize claim-to-source mapping; open a separate branch for mapping after the rights decisions are recorded.
